label: Galaxy S23 smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy S23 — 6.1-inch flagship, Wi-Fi 6E (2.4/5/6 GHz) with 5G sub-6/mmWave; USB-C 3.2 with DeX and dock Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160, 1024-QAM) — first 6 GHz capable S-series for most markets: the interesting case for 6E SSID vs 5 GHz band-steering. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz + mmWave (US SKUs), LTE Cat 20. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1, DeX supported, Ethernet via USB-C dock (usb0).
